messages:
Aisha: Quick catchup from today's onboarding call with LumenHealth — they raised three concrete things: 1) need per-route cost visibility in the Console, 2) onboarding webhook for model/route readiness, 3) occasional hallucination on the FAQ reranker when embeddings are stale.
Miguel: Thanks — can you paste the exact ask for per-route cost visibility? is it a report or a live metric?
Aisha: They want a live toggle in the Console to see cost by route and by model version (so PMs can estimate runbooks during spikes). Said: 'We can't tell which route burned our credits yesterday.'
Sam: Noted. That's a product ask but low-dev surface: we could add a per-route breakdown card to the route details page that pulls sku-level metrics. Prioritization note: would help multiple renewals.
Jordan: For the webhook item — do they need an HTTP callback when a route is fully deployed and warm (cache primed)?
Aisha: Yes exactly. Their ops team wants a signal so they can start integration tests only after the route is ready. They currently poll which is flaky.
Riley: I can scope a tiny endpoint on our control plane to emit readiness + kv-cache-hit-rate. Should be <3d estimation if no major infra changes.
Miguel: Great. Let's assign priority: per-route cost visibility = P1 for enterprise renewals (affects billing clarity); onboarding webhook = P2; FAQ reranker hallucinations = P3 but we should capture repro.
Aisha: I'll attach the call notes and example transcript in the Loom (link) and add the customer's example prompt that triggers the reranker mismatch.
Sam: Can you add a minimal reproduction steps list? If embeddings staleness is the issue we might suggest a TTL strategy or auto-refresh job.
Aisha: Yep — adding repro + sample dataset to the ticket now.
Jordan: For reranker: can you include the model/version used and embedding model? that narrows root cause quickly.
Aisha: Will do. Also flagged renewal risk: they said ambiguity on billing could push their renewal discussion slower. They asked if we can demo the per-route cost card by next week for their finance lead.
Miguel: Demo timeline: if Riley can deliver a mock or prototype in 4 business days, we can show a prototype in the console (feature-flagged). Riley?
Riley: I'll aim for a mocked prototype by EOD Thursday, real data hookup later.
OpsBot: Deploy scheduled: preview-console/feature-per-route-cost -> env: staging -> eta 2024-03-15T18:00Z
Sam: Perfect. Aisha — let's schedule a 30m walkthrough with LumenHealth finance once Riley has the mock. I'll prepare talking points covering how this maps to unit economics.
Aisha: Scheduling now. Thanks team :heart:
Miguel: I'll create a GH issue and tag with label: cs-customer-impact / priority/P1 and link to the thread.
Aisha: Filing note: customer requested copy of the demo screenshot and an action timeline in the renewal playbook.
Jordan: I'll keep an eye on the reranker repro once Aisha uploads dataset.
Riley: Will post the staging URL here when ready. :rocket:
